name: M3_CMS004MI_LstPrtfVariants
description: This tool can list Printer files Variants for M3. Printer files are used do define documents in M3 output management.

inputParameters.name: PRTF
inputParameters.description: Printer file for which the XML variants are listed.

outputParameters.name: XMLT
outputParameters.description: XML variant identifier for the printer file.

outputParameters.name: XMLD
outputParameters.description: Text description of the XML variant for the printer file.

outputParameters.name: LAIC
outputParameters.description: Option indicating which label source the XML variant uses in the generated XML file.
outputParameters.enumConstants: No Label (1),Standard Message Id (2),Overriding Msg (3),Overriding Name (4)

outputParameters.name: MSID
outputParameters.description: Standard message ID used as the default label for the XML variant.

outputParameters.name: MSGF
outputParameters.description: Message file containing the standard message ID used as the default label for the XML variant.

outputParameters.name: OVM7
outputParameters.description: Overriding message ID used as an alternative label for the XML variant.

outputParameters.name: OVMF
outputParameters.description: Message file containing the overriding message ID used as an alternative label for the XML variant.

outputParameters.name: OVNM
outputParameters.description: Overriding name used as a custom label for the XML variant when no overriding message ID is defined.

outputParameters.name: FSMG
outputParameters.description: Indicator whether to fall back to the standard message text as label when no translation exists for the XML variant.
